notes.title: Madness Arena at Anime Festival Asia 2024! 🎮✨
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce that Madness Arena will be making its debut at Anime Festival Asia 2024 from 29th Nov to 1st Dec! 🎉
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181296/d92922d0f372a2116a2b4608f417d137e466739d.jpg[/img]
🔥 Event Highlights:

Daily Mini Tournaments with a Grand Finals happening on Sunday, 1st Dec!
Meet our in-game character brought to life by our amazing cosplayer at the booth.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181296/e144526397490a3cda9c1165f2d10fc100bcf9a8.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Booth: C20
[*] Location: Suntec Singapore Convention & Exhibition Centre
[*] Event: https://animefestival.asia/afasg24/
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181296/9c9de863c58517eb743fbb75848d30f6f4b191fd.png[/img]
Win prizes in collaboration with Razer Gold when you dominate the tournament!
When you purchase the game, participate in our Lucky Draw—the grand prize is a brand-new PS5!
Don’t miss the action and fun! See you at AFA 2024! 🎮🎭

#MadnessArena #AFA2024 #razergold #AnimeFestivalAsia #GamingCommunity.
